best_lineage.idea: Reorder loops to i-k-j to enable streaming of B and C rows and improve cache performance, which should significantly boost GFLOPS by enhancing data locality and enabling better vectorization.

The loop reordering i-k-j is correct for performance, but the function must initialize C to zero before accumulating results, as the harness initializes C with garbage and expects matmul to overwrite all elements, which the current code fails to do for n=1 due to uninitialized memory access. Adding zero initialization fixes correctness while preserving the performance benefits.
